svg.text: Set Block Decoding: one model, causal past + bidirectional block
A · Training mask (one pass, 8 clean + 8 noisy, k = 4)
block sees all clean tokens before it
B · Decoding one block with the entropy-bounded sampler
γ = 0.15 · reveal the largest s with H(1) + … + H(s−1) ≤ γ
Pass 2: condition on the revealed pair
Committed block is then KV-cached causally; next block starts at t + k.
Cost: the first pass of each block also writes the previous block's KV, so it processes
2k positions; later passes process k. Decoding is memory-bound, so either costs about
